HyOptimizer

HyOptimizer67 FPS+ — Fabric performance pack for Minecraft 1.21.11. Sodium, Iris, and pre-tuned configs so the game stays light without looking cheap. By Reinshyy.

HyOptimizer is a Fabric performance pack for Minecraft 1.21.11, shipped as HyOptimizer67 FPS+. It is built around Sodium 0.8, Iris 1.10, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, ImmediatelyFast, EntityCulling, MoreCulling, BadOptimizations, and StutterFix — plus QoL extras like Mod Menu, Zoomify, Mouse Tweaks, Bridging, Accurate Block Placement, Freecam, and ClientSort. Configs are already dialed in, so you install the pack and play. Visuals stay sharp: Iris shaders, LambDynamicLights, and bundled packs including ReShaded, Prime's HD Textures, Luster, Nature X, Better Leaves, Seraphic PBR, and SeraPack. Loader: Fabric 0.18.4. Minecraft: 1.21.11. By Reinshyy.
